name: Ina (Nagano, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ina city emblem in light blue, pink and green: light blue and pink stylised mountains above a green curved stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Ina, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 31 March 2006; the emblem dates from 29 May 2005.

features.role: Ina city emblem — light blue and pink stylised mountains above a green curved stroke
